summary: Diff implements major scaffolding for TRP Coins labeling, race completion credit flow, admin TRP grant UI/command parsing, teams listing/creation UI, and a new System page with Secret Holidays CRUD hooks/UI plus backend state/migration additions. However, some acceptance criteria are not evidenced (notably atomic race-complete API behavior, team membership management, correct team cost, and backend authorization enforcement for admin-only operations).

missing_requirements.requirement: Race completion should be a single backend call that persists race performance, updates best performance/leaderboards, and atomically credits TRP Coins, returning awarded amount and resulting balance, with clear rejection if no profile/unauthorized.
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend flow still indicates separate calls for saving race performance and then calling completeRace, so the required atomic all-in-one backend operation is not evidenced; backend completeRace implementation/authorization checks are not visible in the truncated backend diff.

missing_requirements.requirement: Teams backend must support create/list/details and join/leave with a hard 100 member limit; creating a team must deduct exactly 50,000 TRP Coins and fail on insufficient balance.
missing_requirements.reason: Diff shows team types/state and frontend create/list/details hooks, but does not evidence join/leave APIs or enforcement of 100-member join limit. Additionally, backend constant shows TEAM_CREATE_COST = 50_000_000, which does not match the specified 50,000 TRP Coins cost.

missing_requirements.requirement: Teams UI must include join/leave actions that update UI and handle backend errors such as 'team full' at 100 members.
missing_requirements.reason: TeamsPage implements listing and create-team flow with cost messaging, but no join/leave hooks are present in useTeams.ts, and TeamDetailsPage truncation does not evidence join/leave actions or error handling for team-full.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend-enforced award of 900–1000 TRP Coins for completed non-practice races (0 for practice, no balance change), and Race Results must display earned and balance with 'TRP Coins' label.
missing_requirements.reason: UI labeling for TRP Coins is evidenced, but the backend enforcement of award range and practice-mode no-change cannot be confirmed from the truncated backend diff; frontend only conditionally calls completeRace for non-practice, which does not prove backend enforcement.

missing_requirements.requirement: Admin-only backend method to grant arbitrary TRP Coins; non-admins must be rejected; admin UI/command flow must clearly grant TRP Coins.
missing_requirements.reason: Admin UI and command parsing are implemented, but backend-side admin-only authorization enforcement for adminGrantTrpCoins is not evidenced in the truncated backend diff.

missing_requirements.requirement: Secret Holidays must be admin-managed via backend-backed controls; non-admin users cannot add/remove; backend persists and exposes read APIs for all and admin-only management APIs.
missing_requirements.reason: System page UI shows add/remove controls gated by useIsAdmin, and hooks call addHoliday/removeHoliday/getHolidays, but backend admin-only enforcement and persistence semantics are not evidenced in the truncated backend diff (only state/migration types are shown).

hallucinated_features.description: Admin audit log component and related UI integration
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest does not ask for audit logging of admin commands; diff summary references an AdminAuditLog component.

hallucinated_features.description: Rule-based natural language admin command parser supporting actions beyond TRP grants (e.g., title creation, MOTD updates, add text)
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest only requires TRP Coins grant support in the admin command flow; additional command types are not requested.
